analyticalDashboards.description: Dashboard bringing together key HR trends over time—headcount, hours worked, payroll (gross pay and deductions), absence, recruitment volume and cost, and training spend—so you can monitor workforce capacity and cost drivers. It is set up to report on the last 12 months and supports filtering by store region and channel to focus the analysis on specific parts of the business.
analyticalDashboards.title: Employee Performance & Headcount

widget.title: Absence Hours and Absence Hours by Quarter

analyticalDashboards.description: Dashboard that brings together payroll cost (gross pay and deductions), absence hours, and training spend trends across channels (In-Store, Online) and the North region. It supports monitoring month/quarter/year patterns and comparing how payroll- and absence-related measures change over time under the dashboard’s reporting context, with defaults set to the last 12 months and optional geography filters (region and city).
analyticalDashboards.title: Payroll & Absence Analytics

analyticalDashboards.description: This dashboard brings together key workforce productivity indicators—headcount, active headcount, recruitment volume, and recruitment cost—shown as time trends (by month/quarter/year) and headline KPIs. It is intended for monitoring staffing and recruiting performance across regions and channels, with default filtering to the last 12 months and optional constraints for fiscal quarter, store region, and channel.

memoryItems.description: GlobalMart metric conventions › Choosing a date dimension (compiled from docs/knowledge/metric-hierarchy.md)
memoryItems.instruction: GlobalMart has two date dimensions, and choosing the wrong one silently changes the answer.
memoryItems.title: Choosing a date dimension

memoryItems.description: GlobalMart metric conventions › Choosing a date dimension (compiled from docs/knowledge/metric-hierarchy.md)
memoryItems.instruction: Use `transaction_date` for operational questions: daily sales, footfall, stock movement. It is when the transaction happened.
memoryItems.title: Choosing a date dimension

memoryItems.description: GlobalMart metric conventions › Choosing a date dimension (compiled from docs/knowledge/metric-hierarchy.md)
memoryItems.instruction: Use `fiscal_date` for anything compared against a budget or reported by period, because the fiscal year does not start in January.
memoryItems.title: Choosing a date dimension

memoryItems.description: GlobalMart metric conventions › Choosing a date dimension (compiled from docs/knowledge/metric-hierarchy.md)
memoryItems.instruction: When a question says "last quarter" in a financial context it means a fiscal quarter, so group by `fiscal_date`.
memoryItems.title: Choosing a date dimension

memoryItems.description: GlobalMart metric conventions › Choosing a revenue metric (compiled from docs/knowledge/metric-hierarchy.md)
memoryItems.instruction: Three metrics have "revenue" in the name and they are not interchangeable.
memoryItems.title: Choosing a revenue metric

memoryItems.description: GlobalMart metric conventions › Choosing a revenue metric (compiled from docs/knowledge/metric-hierarchy.md)
memoryItems.instruction: Use `metric_l1_total_net_revenue` by default. Net revenue is after returns and discounts.
memoryItems.title: Choosing a revenue metric

memoryItems.description: GlobalMart metric conventions › Choosing a revenue metric (compiled from docs/knowledge/metric-hierarchy.md)
memoryItems.instruction: `metric_l1_sql_margin_bridge_gross_revenue` is gross, before returns and discounts. It exists for the margin bridge and is the wrong figure elsewhere.
memoryItems.title: Choosing a revenue metric

memoryItems.description: GlobalMart metric conventions › Choosing a revenue metric (compiled from docs/knowledge/metric-hierarchy.md)
memoryItems.instruction: `metric_l1_sql_net_sales_summary_net_revenue` agrees with total net revenue but is scoped to its own SQL dataset's grain, so it does not slice by every dimension.
memoryItems.title: Choosing a revenue metric

memoryItems.description: GlobalMart metric conventions › Metric layers (compiled from docs/knowledge/metric-hierarchy.md)
memoryItems.instruction: GlobalMart's metrics are layered, and the layer is in both the metric id and its tags, L1 through L5.
memoryItems.title: Metric layers

memoryItems.description: GlobalMart metric conventions › Metric layers (compiled from docs/knowledge/metric-hierarchy.md)
memoryItems.instruction: L1 metrics (`metric_l1_*`) are base aggregations over a single fact column. They are the only layer that touches a fact directly.
memoryItems.title: Metric layers

memoryItems.description: GlobalMart metric conventions › Metric layers (compiled from docs/knowledge/metric-hierarchy.md)
memoryItems.instruction: L2 metrics (`metric_l2_cross_*`) are ratios between two L1 metrics, such as order count over net revenue.
memoryItems.title: Metric layers

memoryItems.description: GlobalMart metric conventions › Metric layers (compiled from docs/knowledge/metric-hierarchy.md)
memoryItems.instruction: L3 metrics (`metric_l3_*`) apply a filter to an L1 or L2 metric, usually a WHERE on a dimension attribute such as channel type.
memoryItems.title: Metric layers

memoryItems.description: GlobalMart metric conventions › Metric layers (compiled from docs/knowledge/metric-hierarchy.md)
memoryItems.instruction: L4 and L5 metrics compose further on top of the lower layers.
memoryItems.title: Metric layers

memoryItems.description: GlobalMart metric conventions › Metric layers (compiled from docs/knowledge/metric-hierarchy.md)
memoryItems.instruction: Prefer the lowest layer that answers the question. Total net revenue is an L1 metric; net revenue for one channel is an existing L3 metric, not an L1 metric with a filter added.
memoryItems.title: Metric layers

metrics.description: Shows the total number of hours employees were absent by summing Absence Hours. Use it to monitor overall absence volume and compare totals across time periods or other breakdowns.
metrics.title: Total Absence Hours (Absence)

metrics.description: Totals the Hours Worked values to show overall employee labor hours for the current selection and any applied filters. Use it to track aggregate time effort in the Employee Hours data across employees or time periods.
metrics.title: Total Hours Worked (Employee Hours)

metrics.description: Shows the total number of active people by summing the Active Count from the Headcount Snapshot data, within the current reporting context (such as the selected time period or applied filters). Use it to track active headcount across organizational or time breakdowns.
metrics.title: Total Active Count (Headcount Snapshot)

metrics.description: Shows the total number of employees by summing the Headcount measure from the Headcount Snapshot dataset. Use it to track overall workforce size and break it down by the selected filters, such as time period or organizational structure.
metrics.title: Total Headcount (Headcount Snapshot)

metrics.description: Shows the total amount deducted across payroll transactions within the current reporting scope (such as applied filters and selected time period). Use it to summarize withholdings (taxes and deductions withheld from employee pay by the employer)/deductions by payroll dimensions like employee or pay period.
metrics.title: Total Deductions (Payroll Transaction)

metrics.description: Shows the total gross pay amount by summing Gross Pay across all payroll transactions within the current reporting context (such as selected dates, employees, or other filters). Use it as a core payroll cost measure when analyzing Payroll Transaction data.
metrics.title: Total Gross Pay (Payroll Transaction)

metrics.description: Tracks total recruiting spend by summing the Recruitment (the process of sourcing and hiring new employees) Cost values from the Recruitment dataset. Use this metric to monitor overall recruitment costs and compare spending across time periods, teams, or other recruitment dimensions.
metrics.title: Total Recruitment Cost (Recruitment)

metrics.description: Measures the total number of recruitments (the process of sourcing and hiring new employees) by summing the Recruitment Count from the Recruitment dataset. Use it to track overall recruitment volume and compare performance across slices such as time, location, or other recruitment-related dimensions.
metrics.title: Total Recruitment Count (Recruitment)

metrics.description: Shows total training spend by summing Training Cost from the Training Completion data, within the current reporting context (for example by time period, course, or other applied filters).
metrics.title: Total Training Cost (Training Completion)

metrics.description: Total employee labor hours worked, restricted to the In-Store sales channel. Use this metric to monitor in-store staffing effort while applying other filters such as time period or location.
metrics.title: Hours Worked (Employee Hours) — In-Store Channel

metrics.description: Shows total employee labor hours worked, filtered to the Online sales channel. Use it to monitor labor effort attributable to Online activity and compare it with hours in other channels under the same reporting context.
metrics.title: Hours Worked (Employee Hours) — Online Channel

metrics.description: Totals employee hours worked for the North region only. Use it to monitor labor effort specific to North while still honoring any additional filters applied in a report or dashboard.
metrics.title: Hours Worked (Employee Hours) — North Region

metrics.description: Total gross pay from payroll transactions, filtered to activity associated with the In-Store sales channel. Use this metric to analyze payroll costs specifically for in-store operations within the current reporting context (for example, the selected time period or employee filters).
metrics.title: Gross Pay (Payroll Transaction) — In-Store Channel

metrics.description: Total gross pay from payroll transactions restricted to activity in the Online sales channel. Use this metric to assess payroll costs attributable to online-channel operations within the current reporting context (such as the selected time period or employee breakdowns).
metrics.title: Gross Pay (Payroll Transaction) — Online Channel

metrics.description: Shows total gross pay from payroll transactions, restricted to the North region. Use it to track and compare payroll cost totals for North across any other selected reporting filters such as date or employee.
metrics.title: Gross Pay (Payroll Transaction) — North Region

metrics.description: Shows the total payroll transaction deductions for the In-Store sales channel. Use it to analyze and compare deduction amounts tied specifically to in-store activity within the current report filters and time period.
metrics.title: Deductions (Payroll Transaction) — In-Store Channel

metrics.description: Shows the total amount deducted from payroll transactions for the Online sales channel only. Use it to monitor and report payroll deductions tied to Online activity within the current time period and any other report filters.
metrics.title: Deductions (Payroll Transaction) — Online Channel

metrics.description: Total payroll transaction deductions restricted to the North region. Use this metric to track and compare North’s deduction totals within whatever time period and other reporting filters are applied.
metrics.title: Deductions (Payroll Transaction) — North Region

metrics.description: Total employee absence hours, filtered to the In-Store sales channel. Use this metric to track and compare in-store absence volume over time or across other business breakdowns.
metrics.title: Absence Hours (Absence) — In-Store Channel

metrics.description: Total employee absence hours filtered to records associated with the Online sales channel type. Use it to track and compare online-channel absence volume across time or other business breakdowns.
metrics.title: Absence Hours (Absence) — Online Channel

metrics.description: Shows the total number of employee absence hours, filtered to the North region. Use it to monitor absence volume in North and compare it across time periods or other breakdowns.
metrics.title: Absence Hours (Absence) — North Region

metrics.description: Total training spend from Training Completion data, filtered to the In-Store sales channel. Use this metric to monitor and compare in-store training costs across the current reporting context (such as time period, course, or other applied filters).
metrics.title: Training Cost (Training Completion) — In-Store Channel

metrics.description: Shows the total Training Cost from Training Completion records, filtered to the Online sales channel. Use it to monitor online-only training spend within the current reporting context (such as time period, course, or other applied filters).
metrics.title: Training Cost (Training Completion) — Online Channel

metrics.description: Total training spend from Training Completion records, filtered to the North region. Use this metric to monitor training costs in the North within the current reporting context (such as time period, course, or other applied filters).
metrics.title: Training Cost (Training Completion) — North Region

metrics.description: Total employee headcount from the Headcount Snapshot, filtered to the In-Store sales channel. Use this metric to monitor staffing levels for in-store operations over time or across organizational breakdowns.
metrics.title: Headcount (Headcount Snapshot) — In-Store Channel

metrics.description: Total employee headcount from the Headcount Snapshot, filtered to the Online sales channel. Use this metric to monitor workforce size for online operations and analyze how it changes when sliced by time or organizational dimensions.
metrics.title: Headcount (Headcount Snapshot) — Online Channel

metrics.description: Total employee headcount from the Headcount Snapshot data, restricted to the North region. Use this metric to monitor workforce size for North and analyze it over time or by other organizational dimensions.
metrics.title: Headcount (Headcount Snapshot) — North Region

metrics.description: Counts the total number of active people from the Headcount Snapshot data, filtered to the In-Store sales channel. Use this metric to monitor in-store headcount levels over time or when slicing by other report filters.
metrics.title: Active Count (Headcount Snapshot) — In-Store Channel

metrics.description: Shows the total number of active people from the headcount snapshot, filtered to the Online sales channel. Use this metric to track or compare Online active headcount across the selected time period and any other report filters.
metrics.title: Active Count (Headcount Snapshot) — Online Channel

metrics.description: Counts the total number of active people from the Headcount Snapshot data, limited to the North region. Use this metric to monitor North’s active headcount within the current reporting context (such as the selected time period and any other applied filters).
metrics.title: Active Count (Headcount Snapshot) — North Region

metrics.description: Counts the total number of recruitments for the In-Store sales channel. Use this metric to monitor and compare in-store recruitment volume across time periods or other recruitment dimensions. Recruitment refers to the process of sourcing and hiring new employees.
metrics.title: Recruitment Count (Recruitment) — In-Store Channel

metrics.description: Counts the total number of recruitments attributed to the Online sales channel. Use it to monitor and compare online-driven recruitment volume across dimensions such as time, location, or other recruitment breakdowns. Recruitment refers to the process of sourcing and hiring new employees.
metrics.title: Recruitment Count (Recruitment) — Online Channel

metrics.description: Counts the total number of recruitments for the North region only. Use this metric to monitor and compare North’s recruitment volume against other regions or across time. Recruitment refers to the process of sourcing and hiring new employees.
metrics.title: Recruitment Count (Recruitment) — North Region

metrics.description: Total recruitment spend filtered to the In-Store sales channel. Use it to monitor and compare the cost of recruiting for In-Store hiring across time periods or other recruitment dimensions.
metrics.title: Recruitment Cost (Recruitment) — In-Store Channel

metrics.description: Total recruitment spend filtered to the Online sales channel. Use this metric to monitor and compare recruiting costs attributable to online-channel activity versus other channels or overall recruitment spend.
metrics.title: Recruitment Cost (Recruitment) — Online Channel

metrics.description: Total recruitment spending filtered to the North region. Use it to monitor and compare recruiting costs for North versus other regions or across time periods.
metrics.title: Recruitment Cost (Recruitment) — North Region

metrics.description: Returns the minimum value of Total Headcount within the selected data and filters. This metric respects dashboard, visualization, date, and segment filters applied in the analysis context.
metrics.title: Minimum Total Headcount

metrics.description: Returns the minimum weekly value of Total Headcount (Headcount Snapshot) across the selected date range (weekly grain = Transaction Date Week/Year). Respects all applied filters (e.g., region) and computes the minimum over weeks within the remaining analysis context.
metrics.title: Minimum Weekly Total Headcount

metrics.description: Sums the existing {metric/metric_l1_fact_employee_hours_hours_worked} metric across the current analytical context and any applied filters.
metrics.title: Sum of Total Hours Worked Metric
